# configcat_webhook_signing_keys (Ephemeral Resource)

Use this ephemeral resource to access **Webhook Signing Keys** without persisting them to the Terraform plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later. [What is a Webhook in ConfigCat?](https://configcat.com/docs/advanced/notifications-webhooks/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_id" {
  type = number
}

# The Webhook Signing Keys are never persisted to the Terraform plan or state.
ephemeral "configcat_webhook_signing_keys" "test" {
  webhook_id = var.webhook_id
}

# Pass the signing key to a write-only argument of another resource, e.g. a secret store.
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "configcat_webhook_signing_key" {
  secret_id                = "configcat-webhook-signing-key"
  secret_string_wo         = ephemeral.configcat_webhook_signing_keys.test.key1
  secret_string_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `webhook_id` (Number) The ID of the Webhook.

### Read-Only

- `key1` (String, Sensitive) The first signing key.
- `key2` (String, Sensitive) The second signing key.
